changelog: The script has been renamed from sz-cekilis to sz-giveaway.
Fixed vehicle rewards not being given on some servers.
Weapon and item rewards can now be added by typing their exact name.
Fixed item rewards not being given on some servers.
Vehicle rewards now also give the vehicle key.
Fixed item and vehicle key rewards not being given on some QBCore servers.
Fixed an error with some vehicle key systems when a vehicle reward was delivered.
Improved vehicle reward compatibility with more garage systems.
